summary: Describes five types of SNMP applications that use an SNMP engine: command generators, command responders, notification originators, notification receivers and proxy forwarders. It also defines MIB modules for targets, notification filtering and proxy forwarding. It replaces RFC 2263 and was replaced by RFC 2573.

eli5.summary: It lists the five kinds of jobs in an SNMP system. This version replaced an earlier one and was then replaced itself.
